title: The Inheritance of Ephraim and Manasseh
description: The lot fell to the children of Joseph, and the chapter describes the borders of the inheritance for Ephraim and Manasseh, from the Jordan at Jericho through the wilderness and the mountains to Bethel, continuing via Beth-Horon and Gezer to the sea. It concludes with the note that Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites in Gezer but made them perform forced labor.
